# DAViewer 0.7.0

## 本次更新

- 新增「设置 → 内容屏蔽」，可隐藏平台明确标记的 AI 作品、指定标签、画师或单幅作品；设置保存在本机，可随时解除。
- 长按作品卡片可快捷屏蔽作品或画师，同时保留收藏、分享等操作。
- 推荐、搜索、画廊、收藏及相关作品列表统一应用屏蔽规则，当前页全部隐藏时仍可加载更多。
- AI 判断只使用平台提供的创作标记，不根据标签猜测；平台未提供标签或 AI 标记时，相关规则可能无法识别该作品。

## What's New

- Added Settings → Content filters to hide platform-marked AI works, exact tags, artists or individual artworks. Rules are saved locally and can be removed anytime.
- Long-press artwork cards to hide a work or its artist, alongside existing favourite and sharing actions.
- Filters apply across recommendations, search, galleries, favourites and related works. Fully hidden pages still offer a load-more action.
- AI filtering uses only the platform's creation flag, never tag guesses. Works without supplied tags or AI flags may not match the corresponding filters.
